name: @openfinance-os/data-sandbox
description: Open Finance Data Sandbox — interactive client-side explorer for UAE Open Finance Bank Data Sharing payloads. Synthetic data, narratively realistic personas, spec-driven badges. OF-OS Commons contribution.

scripts.build:site: npm run build:spec && npm run build:data && npm run build:avatars && node tools/build-fixture-package.mjs && node tools/build-payload-types.mjs && node tools/build-brand-registry.mjs && node tools/build-fixture-package-py.mjs && node tools/build-labs.mjs && node tools/stage-site.mjs
scripts.build:fixtures: npm run build:spec && npm run build:fixtures:pkgs
scripts.build:fixtures:pkgs: node tools/build-fixture-package.mjs && node tools/build-payload-types.mjs && node tools/build-brand-registry.mjs && node tools/build-fixture-package-py.mjs
scripts.lint: run-p --aggregate-output --continue-on-error lint:no-handauthored lint:no-institution-leak lint:pii-leak lint:no-glyph-only lint:persona-spec-conformance lint:stress-coverage-uniqueness lint:brand-registry-coverage lint:js format:check
scripts.validate:spec-conformance: npm run lint:persona-spec-conformance && vitest run tests/spec-validation.test.mjs tests/spec-validation.insurance.test.mjs tests/rendered-fixture-spec-validation.test.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run verify:spec-shape && npm run build:spec && npm run build:data && npm run build:avatars && npm run build:fixtures:pkgs && node tools/build-labs.mjs && npm run check:dist-clean && node tools/stage-site.mjs && npm run lint && npm run audit:realism && npm test && npm run test:mcp && npm run test:py
scripts.ci:full: npm run ci && npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:perf
